summary: Comprehensive testing of NairaTrack Nigerian Tax & Expense Management App completed. Backend API testing achieved 100% success rate (37/37 tests passed). Frontend testing validated all core features including landing page, authentication, dashboard, transactions, tax calculator, settings (with new Team Access and Export features), AI chat assistant, and Pidgin/English language toggle. Mobile responsive layout verified.

design_issues.issue: Console warning about chart width/height being -1. Charts render correctly but warning appears on initial load.

Pricing cards (Starter ₦2k, Growth ₦4k, Business ₦6k)

Admin login successful redirect to dashboard
Dashboard with Tax Health Score gauge (70/100)
Dashboard income/expenses summary

Paystack/Mono/Resend APIs are MOCKED (empty API keys). Claude AI integration uses Emergent LLM Key and is working. Mobile responsive layout uses bottom navigation bar.
